messages:
mira: Hey team — opened a tiny pass on dark theme tweaks for the console. PR link: https://git.redwood.example/infra/console-theme/pulls/42

mira: Main asks: dashboard charts look washed at smaller opacities, syntax tokens in code blocks lose contrast, and a couple of button labels feel terse. Can people skim and drop accessibility nits?

gabe: Thanks — quick look. I already noticed the chart color for 'errors' (currently #7a5e9f @ 60%) is essentially unreadable on #0b0d0f. Needs stronger luminance.

toni: Agreed on chart reds/alerts. Also we should avoid pure desaturated grays for lines — they disappear behind gridlines on 4k. Suggest bump to ~12% higher lightness.

jules: Copy nit: on the routes table the action button says "Run" — can we change to "Run test" or "Execute"? "Run" feels ambiguous in context.

mira: Good call on copy, Jules. I'd prefer "Execute" for technical clarity. Gabe — can you propose exact hex swaps for charts?

gabe: Yep. Proposed chart palette for dark mode (accessible against #0b0d0f BG):
- Primary line: #9ad3ff
- Success: #7be495
- Warning: #ffd27a
- Error: #ff8f7a (avoid < 4.5:1)
- Secondary/neutral lines: #6b7280 (increase to #8a8f9a if small stroke)

toni: Quick contrast check: Error #ff8f7a on #0b0d0f gives ~5.0:1 at the main weight — borderline but okay for normal text. For 1px lines we should use the darker #ff6b53 to maintain visibility.

aria-checker-bot: automated-scan: code-block-foreground (#bfc7d6) contrast ratio to background #0b0d0f is 4.2:1 — fails AA for body text. Recommend #d6e6ff or increase weight/background.

mira: Good catch. For code tokens we use monospace at 13px (normal body). Need >= 4.5:1. Toni, can you mock a few token foreground variations?

toni: Pasted a quick inline sample:

```
/* code token samples */
.token.keyword { color: #d6e6ff; }
.token.string  { color: #ffd27a; }
.token.comment { color: #6b7280; font-style: italic; }
```

jules: Another accessibility nit: keyboard focus ring on the small icon buttons is hard to spot. Current focus is a 1px semi-transparent outline. Proposal: 2px solid #9ad3ff with 6px outline-offset, or add an inner shadow.

mira: I like the 2px solid. Also we need aria-labels on chart toggles for screen readers — currently just title attributes. Design-bot, can you add the aria checklist to the PR?

design-bot: Added checklist comment to PR: "aria-labels for chart toggles, focus-visible for icon buttons, contrast audit for code blocks".

gabe: One more UX thought — the token heatmap uses a rainbow that maps badly in dark. Maybe switch to a perceptually uniform diverging scale (purple -> amber) so mid-values are distinct without clashing with the pinks in syntax.

toni: Agreed. Try using a Lightness-first scale from #2b0045 -> #ffd27a, keeps midpoints readable.

mira: This is super helpful — I'll update the PR with Gabe's palette and Toni's token example + Jules' copy change. Final ask: if folks could reply with an explicit :+1: or :eyes: once they've scanned, I'll merge in the afternoon and cut a small rollback plan.

jules: :+1: on Execute label and focus ring idea.

gabe: :eyes: will push hex swaps and run contrast checks in storybook.
toni: :+1: will upload token samples to the branch and a before/after screenshot.

mira: Thanks all! If anything breaks in the rollout we have a canary flag on the console route. I'll add a quick note to release notes about the color updates."
